title: Sebastian and the Alibi
author: Quentin Eastwick
blurb: Odile Okonkwo, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
